companyContext: American video game developer and publisher based in Irvine, California, and a subsidiary of Microsoft (via Activision Blizzard). Founded in 1991, Blizzard is renowned for creating critically acclaimed, genre-defining franchises including Warcraft, World of Warcraft, StarCraft, Overwatch, Hearthstone, and Diablo, and operates the Battle.net online gaming service.
brandContext: Lord of Hatred is the second major expansion for Diablo IV, the dark-fantasy action RPG developed by Blizzard Team 3. Released April 28, 2026, it concludes the Hatred saga by pitting players against Mephisto, the Prime Evil of Hatred, across the ancient sun-soaked islands of Skovos. The expansion introduces two new playable classes — the Paladin (Wardens of Light) and the Warlock — alongside a new campaign, overhauled endgame activities (War Plans, Echoing Hatred), Horadric Cube crafting, transmutation, set bonuses, major Skill Tree reworks, level cap increases, and new Mercenaries, mounts, and cosmetics.

brandVision: To craft the most epic, genre-defining entertainment experiences ever — immersive dark-fantasy worlds that endure for decades, powered by deep storytelling, uncompromising craftsmanship, and a relentless commitment to the players who live within them. With Lord of Hatred, Diablo IV reaches its 'Final Reckoning,' delivering Sanctuary's most ambitious chapter yet and reaffirming Blizzard's long-term, player-first roadmap for the franchise.
brandValues: Gameplay first. Commit to quality. Play nice; play fair. Embrace your inner geek. Every voice matters. Learn and grow. Lead responsibly. Think globally. Translated into the Diablo universe, these values become: visceral, replayable action; uncompromising art direction and dark-fantasy atmosphere; respect for series lore and community feedback; deep build customization and player agency; and shared, social adventure across platforms in a living, evolving Sanctuary.
